title: Frukt Cyder Mixed Berries Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: A lip-smacking blend of blueberry, raspberry, strawberry and blackberry, Frukt Cyder have achieved a premium e-liquid that’s bursting with sweet flavour. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend strikes the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts are found naturally in tobacco, but their recent introduction to the world of e-liquids has opened up a fantastic new way to beat cravings when used with certain types of e-cigarette kits. Unlike traditional freebase nicotine, nicotine salts have a lower PH level which means that higher levels of nicotine can be vaped at lower temperatures. This eliminates the uncomfortable throat hit you would get if you vaped freebase eliquid with a higher nicotine concentration. Nicotine Salt e-liquids are perfect for previously heavy smokers used to high nicotine, and can be vaped in low-resistance kits such as pod kits or starter kits .
